verdict.rationale: A payments SaaS could plausibly ship an in-dashboard AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents an MCP server that lets external AI tools like Claude Desktop and Cursor act on a Mollie account. That is a different capability, not a built-in assistant inside the Mollie product or web app, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
